_note: XAUUSD_1H_AUCTION_CONFLUENCE_LAB v1. Five archetypes tested separately on the 1H slim, mapping each indicator (Custom OB / SMC / NAS / Bubbles / RSI) to an explicit auction-theory function. BB = BigBeluga (Custom OB as canonical proxy). No parameter sweep, no filter selection, no operational promotion.

A1_DEMAND_ABSORPTION_LONG.thesis: Price enters demand zone, recent sell pressure is present, but the market reclaims above the zone high (absorption).
trigger_summary: parent 1H or 4H DEMAND zone exists (Custom OB)
1H bar.low <= zone_high (entered)
sell pressure recent: bubble_sell_recent OR nas_label_short_event in last 5 bars
reclaim: bar.close > zone_high
bullish close (close > open) and body_pct >= 0.4
rsi > 30 (not in deep exhaustion)

A2_CLEAN_DEMAND_REJECTION_LONG.thesis: Price touches demand zone and rejects cleanly with no recent seller activity and no buy climax.
trigger_summary: parent 1H or 4H DEMAND zone exists
1H bar.low <= zone_high (entered) AND close > zone_low (didn't break)
NO sell pressure: NOT bubble_sell_recent AND nas_label_short_event=0 in last 5 bars
NO buy climax: NOT bubble_buy_recent
supply far overhead: nearest_supply_dist > 2*ATR_1H OR null
bullish close AND body_pct >= 0.4

A3_BAD_FALLING_KNIFE_LONG.thesis: Diagnostic negative class. Price enters demand but seller pressure persists and there is no reclaim, with bear structural bias.
trigger_summary: parent 1H or 4H DEMAND zone, bar entered the zone
bubble_sell_recent OR nas_label_short_event in last 5 bars
NO reclaim: bar.close <= zone_high
location_quality in {bad, unclear}
SMC bear bias: BOS bear recent OR CHoCH bear recent

A4_SUPPLY_REJECTION_SHORT.thesis: Price reaches supply zone and rejects cleanly; 1D macro regime NOT confirmed bullish.
trigger_summary: parent 1H or 4H SUPPLY zone exists
1H bar.high >= zone_low (entered) AND close < zone_high (didn't break)
NO buy pressure: NOT bubble_buy_recent AND nas_label_long_event=0 in last 5 bars
NO sell climax: NOT bubble_sell_recent
demand far below: nearest_demand_dist > 2*ATR_1H OR null
bearish close AND body_pct >= 0.4
1D regime NOT bullish (NOT D1a)

A5_BAD_SHORT_IN_BULL_REGIME.thesis: Diagnostic negative class. Same as A4 but 1D macro regime IS bullish (D1a), so short is fighting the tape.
trigger_summary: same trigger as A4 (supply zone rejection)
AND 1D regime bullish: close_1D > EMA200_1D AND EMA50_1D > EMA200_1D (D1a definition)

indicator_roles.market_order_bubbles: aggressor pressure / absorption or climax candidate

zone_definition.rationale: Custom OB is the canonical slim representation of BigBeluga-style supply/demand zones. SMC OB fields are NOT used as the primary zone source in v1.
zone_definition.zone_lookup: 1H bar uses its OWN Custom OB fields for 1H-source zones; for 4H zones, parent 4H bar via bisect_right(ts) - 1; the zone whose edge is closer to current 1H close is picked.

regimes.note: Window is 2024-05 → 2026-05 — entirely inside bull_recent. By construction, every SHORT in this window classifies as A5 because 1D regime is bullish throughout.
